extracted.name: Oreo Pie Crust
extracted.description: Quick and easy homemade Oreo Pie Crust requires only two ingredients, and tastes so much better than from the store.
instruction_lines: Add the whole Oreo cookies to a food processor and pulse into fine crumbs. Pour the crumbs into a bowl and stir in melted butter.
Press mixture evenly and firmly into the bottom and up the sides of a 9 inch pie dish (I like to use the back of a small measuring cup to press). Bake for 10-12 minutes. Set aside to cool
categories: how to make oreo cookie crust
